about.description: SPYX is an ETF perpetual listed on Gate, tracking State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only - no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Gate prices this market off the Backed xStock token for State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, a tokenized representation of the listed shares rather than the shares themselves. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 75x leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
